pay_as_you_go.name: Pay by days
pay_as_you_go.desc: Pay only for the days you trade. Top up any number of days — access ends when they run out. No auto-renewal.

weekly.name: Weekly
weekly.desc: Seven days of full access. Good for trying a strategy or trading an event week.

monthly.name: Monthly
monthly.desc: The standard plan. One payment, thirty days of everything.

yearly.name: Yearly
yearly.desc: A full year at the lowest per-day rate. Set it once, forget billing.

choosePlan.title: Pick how you want to pay.
choosePlan.subtitle: Every plan unlocks the full terminal — 500+ tickers, custom rules, charts and alerts. The only difference is duration and price.
choosePlan.footnote: all plans · 500+ tickers · custom rules · charts · oi alerts · voice notifications

payByDays.title: How much do you want to top up?
payByDays.subtitle: Enter any amount. We'll convert it to days of full terminal access at the current daily rate — no auto-renewal, access ends when your days run out.
payByDays.invalidMessage: Invalid amount — try entering a different amount.

paymentMethod.title: How do you want to pay?
paymentMethod.subtitle: Pick a method to complete your subscription. More providers are being added — for now Multicard covers Uzbek bank cards.
paymentMethod.multicardDesc: Uzbek bank cards — UZCARD & HUMO. Charged in UZS. Instant activation.

summary.title: Order summary
summary.paygPeriod: Pay by days · {{duration}} of full terminal access
summary.note: You will be redirected to Multicard to complete payment securely. No auto-renewal — access ends when your subscription runs out.

paymentMethod.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
paymentMethod.checkoutFailed: Could not start checkout. Please try again.

unknownPlan.title: No plan selected
unknownPlan.body: We couldn't find the plan you were paying for. Head back to choose one.

confirming.title: Confirming your payment…
confirming.subtitle: Your bank and Multicard are settling the transaction. This can take up to a minute — keep this tab open.
confirming.footNote: Do not refresh or navigate away. If confirmation takes longer than 90 seconds we'll stop and let you retry.

success.title: You're all in
success.subtitle: Full terminal access is live on your account — real-time books, custom rules and alerts across every supported ticker.
success.footNote: A receipt has been emailed to {{email}}. No auto-renewal — access simply ends when your subscription runs out.

timeout.title: Payment not completed
timeout.subtitle: We didn't receive a confirmation from Multicard in time. Your plan hasn't been activated and you have not been charged.
timeout.banner: We couldn't confirm this payment within 90 seconds. If your card was charged it will be reversed automatically — nothing was activated.
timeout.footNote: Charged anyway? Any unconfirmed authorisation is released by your bank automatically, usually within a few business days.

declined.title: Payment failed
declined.subtitle: Something went wrong. Please try again — no money was charged.
declined.bannerFallback: The payment provider reported an error.
declined.footNote: No charge was made. You can try another card or plan whenever you're ready.

refunded.title: Money refunded
refunded.subtitle: This payment was refunded and the charge reversed. Your existing access stays active until it expires.
refunded.bannerFallback: This payment was reversed by the provider.
refunded.footNote: The refund should appear on your statement within a few business days.

notfound.title: Order not found
notfound.subtitle: We couldn't find an active order, or your invoice has been canceled. Did you cancel your payment?
notfound.banner: If you canceled your order, ignore this message. Otherwise try refreshing this page or start the payment again.
notfound.footNote: Already paid? Give it a minute and refresh — confirmations can lag behind the redirect.

unpaidInvoice.label: Unpaid invoice
unpaidInvoice.body: The payment didn't go through. Retry it, switch to a different plan, or cancel the invoice.

admin.sub: You have admin access — unlimited, with no expiry date.

trial.sub: You're on the free trial. Subscribe to keep access when it ends — no card was taken.

active.subRenewing: Renewal window is open. Pay once to extend — access ends on the date above otherwise.
active.subCovered: You're covered. Payments are one-time — nothing renews automatically.

expired.sub: You have no active access. Choose a plan — or top up a few days to get straight back in.
expired.footnote: your rules and settings are kept

payByDays.label: Pay by days
payByDays.body: Pay any amount, any time — no renewal window. We convert it to days and add them on top of your current access.
payByDays.footnote: from 1 day, any amount · one-time payment

history.title: Billing history
history.caption: {{orders}} · {{grants}} · access through {{access}}
history.grantsNote: Only successful grants appear here — trials, paid purchases and admin credits. Failed or expired orders never grant access, so they live under Payments.

empty.title: No payments yet
empty.body: You haven't made any payment attempts. When you subscribe or top up, every order shows up here — paid, pending or failed.

checkoutStub.title: Payment coming soon
checkoutStub.noPlan: No plan selected. Head back to pricing to choose one.
checkoutStub.placeholder: The payment flow isn't wired up yet — this is a placeholder for it.
